name: What to Expect During Cabinet Installation in Your DFW Remodel

step.name: Step 1: Site and Product Inspection – Before any installation begins, your design-build team will meticulously inspect the project site. This includes verifying dimensions against the approved plans and checking for level floors and plumb walls. Simultaneously, all delivered cabinets are carefully inspected for any damage or missing components. This crucial step prevents issues from escalating later in the project.
step.text: Step 1: Site and Product Inspection – Before any installation begins, your design-build team will meticulously inspect the project site. This includes verifying dimensions against the approved plans and checking for level floors and plumb walls. Simultaneously, all delivered cabinets are carefully inspected for any damage or missing components. This crucial step prevents issues from escalating later in the project.

step.name: Step 2: Preparation and Layout – Walls are marked to locate studs and utility lines, ensuring fasteners won’t hit pipes or electrical wires. Reference lines are established for level and plumb, even on uneven floors or walls, to guarantee a perfectly aligned installation. This attention to detail is vital for the structural integrity and aesthetic appeal of your new cabinetry.

step.name: Step 3: Securing Base and Wall Cabinets – The installation typically begins with securing starting cabinets, often a corner base cabinet. These are carefully aligned, joined, shimmed as needed, and securely fastened to the wall studs. The process then extends to all base, wall, tall, and island units, ensuring each piece is perfectly plumb and level. Proper shimming is essential, especially in older DFW homes, to create a stable and even surface for countertops.

step.name: Step 4: Customization and Finishing – Once the main cabinet boxes are in place, custom fillers, panels, and trim pieces are precisely fitted. These elements conceal gaps and create a seamless, integrated look. Doors, drawers, and hardware are then installed and adjusted to ensure smooth operation and uniform spacing. Appliance and sink openings are also verified to ensure everything is ready for subsequent trades.

step.name: Step 5: Post-Installation Coordination – After cabinets are installed, the next critical step is countertop templating. Measurements for your new countertops can only be taken once the cabinets are securely and correctly in place. This coordination is essential for a precise fit. Following countertops, the plumbing, electrical, and appliance installation can proceed, bringing your space closer to completion.

step.name: Step 6: Final Adjustments and Walkthrough – The installation concludes with final adjustments to doors and drawers, ensuring everything operates perfectly. Your project manager will then conduct a thorough walkthrough with you. This is your opportunity to inspect the craftsmanship, ask questions, and confirm your satisfaction with the completed custom cabinetry. Any minor adjustments are handled promptly, reinforcing our commitment to your homeowner experience.
step.text: What to Expect During the Process: Professional cabinet installation is a detailed process that integrates with various other trades. Its success hinges on expert planning and precise execution. The timeline depends on the kitchen size, cabinet type, and complexity of the trim work, but typically spans a few days to a week for the physical installation, not including fabrication time. AKN Design Group provides that single point of coordination, managing these complexities to deliver a cohesive, high-quality result, enhancing functionality and beauty for your DFW home.
